_help: Maps Discogs genres and styles to your Shopify collection names. A record goes into EVERY collection it matches. Edit freely: collection names must match Shopify exactly. Discogs genres: https://www.discogs.com/search/?type=release (see the Genre and Style filters).
_styleContains_help: Any style containing this text goes into these collections (e.g. 'Heavy Metal', 'Thrash' needs its own line).
_fallbacks_help: If a record has this Discogs genre but none of the listed collections were matched by its styles, use these instead.
